moments.text: After 12 s of black screen: infrared view looking down on a rippled sea with a large dark patch; the sensor holds steady.
A bright shape with a dark smudge beside it enters at the top right edge; the sensor follows it down toward the centre-right.
The sensor whips away (a smeared frame, a white flash), then zooms in on a small bright shape trailing a dark wake on the water.
The view moves to a large ship seen from above at the left of the frame, with churned water beside it.
A tiny dark dash streaks right to left along the bottom right of the frame, gone in about 0.25 s.
A tiny dark dash crosses from the top edge on the right down to the lower left past the ship; then the view changes.
Over plain grey water, another dark dash streaks from the upper right to the bottom left edge in about half a second.
A dark dash flicks across the lower right toward the bottom edge, visible for about 0.2 s.
A dark dash enters at the right side and streaks down-left to the bottom edge below the crosshair.
A dark dash streaks leftward across the lower right of the frame, about 0.2 s.
Two more dark dashes skim the bottom left corner, at 4:23 and 4:31, each visible for a few frames.

notes: 0:00-0:12 black. Transits are tiny dark dashes lasting 0.2-0.9 s; use frame step. A second bottom-left dash at 4:31 is not in the official list.
